metadata.purpose: Forward the first item and later items whose selected key differs from the previous FORWARDED key.

conditions: At most one original value is emitted per source value. The first is emitted if its key selection succeeds.
Errors and cancellation may truncate output; comparator equality is not suppression based on every past key.

scope.parameters: Key mode identity, comparator mode strict.
scope.callbacks: Key selection and comparator outcomes are external correlated microsteps, not functions executed inside model guards. Default identity/property selection and strict comparison are synthetic model steps, not physical user callback calls.
scope.time: No timers or scheduler introduced. Inputs supply timestamps and tie order; key and comparator microsteps resolve synchronously at the same time.
scope.reentrancy: Non-reentrant source and observer delivery; only plain stable property values are modeled for distinctUntilKeyChanged.
exclusions: Arbitrary reentrant observer/callback behavior and subscriber cancellation DURING an unresolved callback.
Mutation/getter side effects between property comparisons, prototype proxies or throwing property access unless represented as explicit key errors.
Unbounded invocation-counter overflow, a production callback effect interpreter, deprecated overloads not selected here.

initialization.sourceSubscription: One source connection; empty comparison memory.

ownership.sharing: Does not multicast. Each result subscription owns its own last-emitted key.
ownership.reset: Fresh subscribe starts with no previous key; closed executions are not reused.

dispatch.actionSemantics: One source.next requests its key, then optionally a comparison; both phases complete before the next source event.
cancellationCheckpoints: After key/comparison resolution; cancellation releases upstream without notification.

inputs.description: the selected key is available for this source value
the equality test returns a truthy or falsy result

controls.description: no source connection or remembered key
source live, optionally retaining last forwarded key
terminal or cancelled; further input forbidden

actions: subscribe to the source; remember no previous emitted key
rules.nextState: active with no previous key and index zero
rules.explanation: Subscription starts one independent comparison history. No values are emitted until the source sends one.

actions: resolve the incoming key (a synthetic identity/property microstep unless the user supplied a selector)
rules.nextState: one key resolution pending; previous emitted key retained
rules.explanation: Every source value selects a key, including the first and every value later suppressed. Without a user selector this is an identity or property-access microstep; it is not an extra RxJS event or asynchronous task.

rules.guard: matching key resolution and no prior emitted key
actions: store the selected key before forwarding the original value
rules.nextState: active remembering the first emitted key
rules.explanation: The first source value is always forwarded; its selected key is saved before the notification is sent. A key selector, when configured, still runs for this first value.

rules.guard: matching key resolution and a prior emitted key
actions: compare previous emitted key with incoming key
rules.explanation: Subsequent source values compare with the key of the last FORWARDED value, not necessarily the immediately preceding input. The comparator receives previous key first, current key second.

rules.guard: matching comparison with falsy equality result
actions: replace the stored key before forwarding the original value
rules.nextState: active with new previous emitted key
rules.explanation: When the comparator says the keys differ, forward the original value and replace the remembered key before downstream delivery.

rules.guard: matching comparison with truthy equality result
rules.nextState: active keeping the previous FORWARDED key
rules.explanation: When the comparator says equal, emit nothing and do not replace the previous emitted key. Future values compare against the last value actually forwarded.
If selecting the key throws, forward the exact error and release the source. No input value or completion follows.
A comparator error terminates the stream immediately and releases the source without a final value.

rules.guard: no unresolved synchronous key or comparison
rules.explanation: Source completion forwards completion without emitting a stored value, then releases the source subscription.

rules.guard: no unresolved synchronous key or comparison
rules.explanation: A source error passes through unchanged, then source resources are released; no completion follows.
Downstream cancellation releases source ownership without producing a completion notification.
